posts.author: ema200wizard
posts.text: Nifty Is Down 26% From Its High — Yeah, USD/INR makes quite a difference here. Nifty is down around 14-15% in rupee terms, but with USD/INR moving from ~83.6 to ~96.3, the fall comes to nearly 26% in dollar terms. At the same time, SIP flows have gone from ~₹96,000 crore in FY21 to around ₹3.5 lakh crore in FY26. So while the dollar drawdown is much bigger, the domestic flow base is also much bigger than it was earlier. Anyways, I’ve started putting some money into large and mid-cap funds now. Let’s see how it plays out from here.
